9	/-!
10	# The `HasRigidPushforward` gate, factored into its exact remaining leaves
11	
12	`Picard/RigidPushforward.lean` declares the campaign gate
13	`Scheme.HasRigidPushforward C` (:373) with two fields, `locallyFree` and
14	`baseChange`, and no instance anywhere in the tree.  The purpose of this file
15	is to make the *shape* of the discharge exact: to say, as machine-checked Lean
16	rather than prose, precisely which statements remain and how they compose into
17	the gate.
18	
19	## The factorization
20	
21	For an AJC curve — `C : Over (Spec k)` with
22	`[SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]`
23	— the gate is *equivalent* to four named statements, three of which concern
24	only `ℙ¹`:
25	
26	1. **`P1HasTrivialConstants k`** (`Picard/RigidPushforwardP1Constants.lean`):
27	   `Γ(ℙ¹_k, 𝒪) = k`.  Pushed there all the way down to geometric integrality
28	   of the integral model `Proj ℤ[X₀, X₁]`.
29	2. **`P1CechFibrewiseBridge k A`** (§1 here): fibrewise `Ȟ¹`-vanishing of `M`
30	   on `ℙ¹_A` at all scheme points forces the base-linear Čech differential to
31	   stay surjective after `⊗ κ(𝔪)` at maximal ideals.  This is the geometric
32	   half of Mumford's "vanishing on the closed fibres" hypothesis, in the
33	   spelling the algebraic engine consumes.
34	3. **`P1PushforwardLocalFreenessBridge k A`** (§2 here): the *output* bridge —
35	   the engine's module-level conclusion (`d` surjective, `H⁰ = ker d` finite
36	   projective, `H⁰` commuting with arbitrary base change) upgraded to the
37	   sheaf-level conclusion that `p_* M` is locally free of pointwise rank
38	   `p.fiberH0 M t`.
39	4. **`Scheme.RigidPushforwardBaseChange C A`** — the second gate field, for
40	   which the tree currently has *no* infrastructure at all (see the caveat
41	   below).
42	
43	§3 assembles 1–3 into `P1RigidPushforwardStatement k A`, the sole hypothesis
44	of `rigidPushforwardLocallyFree_of_p1Engine`
45	(`Picard/RigidPushforwardTransfer.lean`:1391), hence into the gate's
46	`locallyFree` field; §4 assembles everything into `HasRigidPushforward C`.
47	Note that `HasFiniteMapToP1 C`, which the transfer package needs, is **not** a
48	leaf: it synthesizes for an AJC curve through
49	`hasFiniteMapToP1_of_existsNonconstantMapToP1` ∘
50	`existsNonconstantMapToP1_of_existsNonconstantMapToProjInt` ∘
51	`existsNonconstantMapToProjInt_of_ajc`
52	(`RiemannRoch/Adelic/{FiniteMapToP1,NonconstantToP1}.lean`), all sorry-free.
53	
54	## Caveat on the `baseChange` field (recorded, not hidden)
55	
56	`Scheme.RigidPushforwardBaseChange` asks for `IsIso` of the adjoint mate
57	`pushforwardBaseChangeMap` for the **proper** family `q : C_A ⟶ Spec A` and
58	*arbitrary* ring maps `A → A'`.  The tree's only `IsIso` theorems for that
59	mate (`isIso_pushforwardBaseChangeMap_of_isPullback`,
60	`Picard/RigidPushforwardTransfer.lean`:1108, and its chart form :949) require
61	`[IsAffineHom f]`, and with `IsAffineHom q` assumed the field closes in one
62	line — so the entire content of the field is the non-affine case.  There is
63	also no composition/pasting API for `pushforwardBaseChangeMap` in the tree, so
64	the natural "reduce along the finite `π_A`, then treat `p : ℙ¹_A ⟶ Spec A`"
65	strategy cannot yet be assembled even once the second half exists.  The
66	module-level input is available (`kerBaseChange` bijective for *every*
67	`Γ(Spec A, ⊤)`-algebra, the fourth conclusion of
68	`p1Cech_h0_baseChange_of_fibrewise_h1_vanishing`); the sheaf-level bridge is
69	not.  This is deliberately left as the fourth leaf rather than papered over.
70	
71	Sources: Mumford, *Abelian Varieties*, II §5; EGA III 7.9.9; Hartshorne III
72	12.11; Kleiman, *The Picard scheme* (FGA Explained), §5; Stacks 02KG.
73	-/

89	/-! ## §1. Leaf 2 — the fibrewise Čech bridge on `ℙ¹_A`
90	
91	The engine `p1Cech_h0_baseChange_of_fibrewise_h1_vanishing`
92	(`Picard/RigidPushforwardP1Engine.lean`:1198) runs Nakayama over the maximal
93	ideals of `Γ(Spec A, ⊤)`, so it needs `H¹` vanishing in the form
94	"`d ⊗ (R₀ ⧸ 𝔪)` is surjective".  `P1RigidPushforwardStatement` supplies `H¹`
95	vanishing in the *geometric* form `Hom.FiberH1Vanishing` — vanishing of the
96	concrete Čech `Ȟ¹` of `M_t` on *some* 2-affine cover of the scheme-theoretic
97	fibre `ℙ¹_t`, at *every* scheme point `t`.  This `Prop` is exactly the
98	implication between the two. -/
99	
100	/-- **Leaf 2 (the fibrewise bridge)**: on `ℙ¹_A`, fibrewise Čech
101	`h¹`-vanishing of a finitely presented `M` at every scheme point implies that
102	the base-linear Čech difference map of the standard 2-chart cover stays
103	surjective after tensoring with the residue field `R₀ ⧸ 𝔪` of every maximal
104	ideal.
105	
106	Both directions of the mismatch are favourable: the hypothesis ranges over
107	*all* scheme points while the conclusion needs only the closed ones, and
108	cover-independence of the fibrewise `Ȟ¹` is already unconditional
109	(`Scheme.Hom.FiberH1Vanishing.surjective_moduleSectionDiff`,
110	`Cohomology/StructureSheafModuleK/QuasicoherentDegreeOneVanishing.lean`).
111	What remains is the chart-level base-change identification
112	`κ(t) ⊗_{Γ(Spec A, ⊤)} Γ(M, U_i) ≅ Γ(M_t, U_i^t)`, i.e. Stacks 02KG in
113	degree `0` on each affine chart of `ℙ¹_A`. -/
114	def P1CechFibrewiseBridge (k : Type u) [Field k]
115	    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] : Prop :=
116	  ∀ (M : (Limits.pullback (p1Over k).hom
117	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).Modules),
118	    M.IsFinitePresentation →
119	    (∀ t : Spec (CommRingCat.of A),
120	      (pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom
121	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).FiberH1Vanishing M t) →
122	    letI := (pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom
123	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).baseSectionsModule M
124	        (p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).U₁
125	    letI := (pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom
126	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).baseSectionsModule M
127	        (p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).U₂
128	    letI := (pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom
129	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).baseSectionsModule M
130	        ((p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).U₁ ⊓ (p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).U₂)
131	    ∀ (m : Ideal Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of A), ⊤)), m.IsMaximal →
132	      Function.Surjective
133	        (((p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).moduleSectionDiffBase
134	          (pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom
135	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))) M).baseChange
136	          (Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of A), ⊤) ⧸ m))
137	
138	/-! ## §2. Leaf 3 — the output bridge (module conclusion ⟹ sheaf conclusion)
139	
140	`p1Cech_h0_baseChange_of_fibrewise_h1_vanishing` ends at the level of
141	`Γ(Spec A, ⊤)`-modules: `H⁰ = ker d` is finite projective and its formation
142	commutes with arbitrary base change.  `P1RigidPushforwardStatement` asks
143	instead for the *sheaf* `p_* M` on `Spec A` to be locally free with the
144	pointwise rank `p.fiberH0 M t`.  The two are connected by
145	`AffineCoverMVSquare.globalSectionsEquivKerModuleSectionDiffBase`
146	(`Picard/RigidPushforwardP1Engine.lean`:287, `Γ(ℙ¹_A, M) ≃ₗ ker d`),
147	quasi-coherence of the pushforward (`pushforward_isQuasicoherent`,
148	`Picard/QuotScheme.lean`) and the standard "finite projective localizes to
149	free" argument; the rank identification is the `B = κ(t)` case of the
150	base-change conclusion. -/
151	
152	/-- **Leaf 3 (the output bridge)**: on `ℙ¹_A`, the engine's module-level
153	conclusion for a finitely presented `M` — the base-linear Čech differential
154	`d` surjective, `H⁰ = ker d` a finite projective `Γ(Spec A, ⊤)`-module, and
155	the formation of `H⁰` commuting with arbitrary base change — implies the
156	geometric conclusion of `P1RigidPushforwardStatement`: every `t : Spec A` has
157	an open neighbourhood on which `p_* M` is free of rank `p.fiberH0 M t`.
158	
159	This is pure sheaf-theoretic packaging (no new cohomology): `Γ(Spec A, p_* M)`
160	is `Γ(ℙ¹_A, M) ≅ ker d`, the pushforward is quasi-coherent, a finite
161	projective module over a commutative ring becomes free on a basic open
162	neighbourhood of any prime, and the rank there is the `κ(t)`-dimension of
163	`κ(t) ⊗ ker d ≅ ker (d ⊗ κ(t)) = Γ(ℙ¹_t, M_t)`, i.e. `p.fiberH0 M t`. -/
164	def P1PushforwardLocalFreenessBridge (k : Type u) [Field k]
165	    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] : Prop :=
166	  ∀ (M : (Limits.pullback (p1Over k).hom
167	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).Modules),
168	    M.IsFinitePresentation →
169	    letI := (pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom
170	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).baseSectionsModule M
171	        (p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).U₁
172	    letI := (pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom
173	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).baseSectionsModule M
174	        (p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).U₂
175	    letI := (pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom
176	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).baseSectionsModule M
177	        ((p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).U₁ ⊓ (p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).U₂)
178	    Function.Surjective ⇑((p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).moduleSectionDiffBase
179	        (pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom
180	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))) M) →
181	    Module.Finite Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of A), ⊤)
182	      (LinearMap.ker ((p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).moduleSectionDiffBase
183	        (pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom
184	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))) M)) →
185	    Module.Projective Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of A), ⊤)
186	      (LinearMap.ker ((p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).moduleSectionDiffBase
187	        (pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom
188	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))) M)) →
189	    (∀ (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of A), ⊤) B],
190	      Function.Bijective (AlgebraicJacobian.TwoTerm.kerBaseChange
191	        ((p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).moduleSectionDiffBase
192	          (pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom
193	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))) M) B)) →
194	    ∀ t : Spec (CommRingCat.of A),
195	      ∃ U : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens, t ∈ U ∧
196	        Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).obj
197	            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom
198	              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))).obj M) ≅
199	          _root_.SheafOfModules.free (R := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
200	            (ULift.{u} (Fin ((pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom
201	              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).fiberH0 M t))))
202	
203	/-! ## §3. The ℙ¹ engine statement from the three ℙ¹ leaves -/
204	
205	set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
206	-- Heartbeat headroom for the instance-heavy `letI` environment (fleet recipe).
207	/-- **`P1RigidPushforwardStatement` from its three leaves.**  The pinned ℙ¹
208	engine (`Picard/RigidPushforward.lean`:663) follows from
209	
210	* `P1HasTrivialConstants k` — `Γ(ℙ¹_k, 𝒪) = k` (the `H⁰`-finiteness anchor,
211	  §3 of `Picard/RigidPushforwardP1Constants.lean`);
212	* `P1CechFibrewiseBridge k A` — leaf 2;
213	* `P1PushforwardLocalFreenessBridge k A` — leaf 3;
214	
215	with everything else — the `A`-coefficient Laurent ladder for `H¹`, the Serre
216	dévissage for `H⁰`, the two-term finite replacement, Nakayama, purity of the
217	kernel — already proved in the tree. -/
218	theorem p1RigidPushforwardStatement_of_leaves
219	    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A]
220	    (hk : P1HasTrivialConstants k)
221	    (hfib : P1CechFibrewiseBridge k A)
222	    (hshape : P1PushforwardLocalFreenessBridge k A) :
223	    P1RigidPushforwardStatement k A := by
224	  intro M hfp hflat h1 t
225	  haveI := hfp
226	  obtain ⟨hsurj, hfin, hproj, hbc⟩ :=
227	    p1Cech_h0_baseChange_of_fibrewise_h1_vanishing_of_p1TrivialConstants A hk M hflat
228	      (hfib M hfp h1)
229	  exact hshape M hfp hsurj hfin hproj hbc t
230	
231	/-! ## §4. The gate -/
232	
233	/-- **The `locallyFree` field of the gate from the three ℙ¹ leaves.**  For an
234	AJC curve, `HasFiniteMapToP1 C` is automatic, so the finite-pushforward
235	transfer package (`rigidPushforwardLocallyFree_of_p1Engine`) turns the ℙ¹
236	engine into rank-`χ` local freeness for the constant curve `C_A`. -/
237	theorem rigidPushforwardLocallyFree_of_leaves
238	    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
239	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
240	    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A]
241	    (hk : P1HasTrivialConstants k)
242	    (hfib : P1CechFibrewiseBridge k A)
243	    (hshape : P1PushforwardLocalFreenessBridge k A) :
244	    Scheme.RigidPushforwardLocallyFree C A :=
245	  rigidPushforwardLocallyFree_of_p1Engine A C
246	    (p1RigidPushforwardStatement_of_leaves A hk hfib hshape)
247	
248	/-- **The gate, factored.**  For an AJC curve `C/k`, `HasRigidPushforward C`
249	follows from the ℙ¹ engine statement at every finitely generated `k`-algebra
250	together with the base-change field at every finitely generated `k`-algebra.
251	This is the honest statement of what remains: the `locallyFree` half is
252	`P1RigidPushforwardStatement`, the `baseChange` half is untouched. -/
253	theorem hasRigidPushforward_of_p1Engine_of_baseChange
254	    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
255	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
256	    (hP1 : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A],
257	      P1RigidPushforwardStatement k A)
258	    (hBC : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A],
259	      Scheme.RigidPushforwardBaseChange C A) :
260	    Scheme.HasRigidPushforward C where
261	  locallyFree A := rigidPushforwardLocallyFree_of_p1Engine A C (hP1 A)
262	  baseChange A := hBC A
263	
264	/-- **The gate from the four named leaves.**  The exact remaining frontier of
265	the B3 campaign gate, machine-checked:
266	
267	* `Γ(ℙ¹_k, 𝒪) = k` (one statement, `k`-only, reducible to geometric
268	  integrality of `Proj ℤ[X₀, X₁]`);
269	* the fibrewise Čech bridge on `ℙ¹_A` (leaf 2);
270	* the local-freeness output bridge on `ℙ¹_A` (leaf 3);
271	* the base-change field for the proper family `C_A ⟶ Spec A` (leaf 4, no
272	  infrastructure yet — see the module docstring). -/
273	theorem hasRigidPushforward_of_leaves
274	    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
275	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
276	    (hk : P1HasTrivialConstants k)
277	    (hfib : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A],
278	      P1CechFibrewiseBridge k A)
279	    (hshape : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A],
280	      P1PushforwardLocalFreenessBridge k A)
281	    (hBC : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A],
282	      Scheme.RigidPushforwardBaseChange C A) :
283	    Scheme.HasRigidPushforward C :=
284	  hasRigidPushforward_of_p1Engine_of_baseChange C
285	    (fun A => p1RigidPushforwardStatement_of_leaves A hk (hfib A) (hshape A)) hBC
286
